title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Finland – EGF/2026/004 FI/Etelä-Suomi and Helsinki-Uusimaa paper
part_text: 7. Stresses that expenditure on information and publicity must be strictly limited to providing potentially eligible workers with clear and timely information on the conditions of and access to the measures; rejects the use of EGF appropriations for political communication or institutional self-promotion;
